name: DevSpark
purpose: Turn ideas into structured implementation workflows.
summary: A spec-driven, agent-agnostic development harness for moving from intent to implementation-ready plans, tasks, and reviewable context.
valueProposition: DevSpark helps teams turn fuzzy ideas into precise, agent-ready implementation workflows.
capabilities: Reviewable handoffs from idea to code
philosophy: DevSpark treats AI-assisted development as a systems problem. Better outputs come from clearer specifications, explicit constraints, and workflow context that can be reviewed before code is produced.
whatItIs: DevSpark is the flagship Make Bold Spark system for spec-driven development workflows.
whyItExists: It exists to make AI-assisted software delivery more deliberate, inspectable, and repeatable.

name: ApiTestSpark
purpose: Explore APIs and validate repeatable request workflows.
summary: A system for OpenAPI-driven exploration, API testing, and repeatable workflow validation.
valueProposition: ApiTestSpark turns API contracts and live behavior into practical testing and implementation context.
philosophy: ApiTestSpark starts from the contract, then grounds the work in concrete request behavior so documentation, tests, and clients stay close to reality.
whatItIs: ApiTestSpark is the Make Bold Spark system for API exploration and workflow testing.
whyItExists: It exists because reliable API work needs more than static documentation; it needs repeatable examples and observable behavior.

name: WebSpark
purpose: Capture the long-running web platform lineage behind Make Bold Spark.
summary: A web platform and reference implementation lineage for content, publishing, recipes, and reusable application patterns.
valueProposition: WebSpark provides the practical web application foundation that informs the Make Bold Spark ecosystem.
philosophy: WebSpark favors real application patterns over abstract demos, preserving the lessons that come from maintaining web systems over time.
whatItIs: WebSpark is the web platform and application lineage behind many Make Bold Spark reference systems.
whyItExists: It exists to keep reusable web patterns grounded in working software.

name: MakeBoldSpark
purpose: Provide focused API examples, integration patterns, and reusable service implementations.
summary: An API-focused reference system for small focused APIs, integration patterns, public content endpoints, and service examples.
valueProposition: MakeBoldSpark demonstrates focused API design patterns that can be inspected, tested, and reused.
capabilities: Health, auth, and async workflow examples
philosophy: MakeBoldSpark keeps API examples small enough to understand while still being real enough to validate architecture, testing, and integration choices.
whatItIs: MakeBoldSpark is the API-focused reference implementation for small APIs, integration patterns, and reusable service implementations.
whyItExists: It exists to make API architecture and integration patterns concrete.
